scope: All existing T01 saved records; exact-byte duplicate texts may be read once retaining all aliases and ordered fulltext coverage. No new cipher output is generated.
reviewerSeparation: Readers do not read each other current judgments; original-source/prior-experiment exposure disclosed. Both are AI readers, not a calibrated statistical oracle.
beforeReading: Verify whole source identity and exact schema/record/order counts
Prove lossless mapping of each saved record UTF8 to its deduplicated complete text group
Register public plan before semantic reader execution
recognitionCriterion: A coherent second message or determinate next puzzle operation beyond ordinary article rhetoric/fragments, recognized in the exact complete saved string with explicit source basis. Incidental themes or unconstrained pattern suggestions do not count.
noRecognitionCriterion: Neither complete AI review recognizes such an instruction; report only subjective nonrecognition in this finite fixed population, not formal plaintext/key/cipher/puzzle exclusion.
forbiddenReviewOperations: word filtering or substring search sweep
positiveHandling: Record the exact existing group/source basis privately and propose a separate later protocol; do not publish raw selected key material or act on it.
